facts.where: Table 6 caption
facts.quote: Table 6: Prospective model results. Paired counts: treatment-only/control-only/ties; p p : exact two-sided sign test (BC: pre-registered block-Holm value in parentheses). ‘indep. endpoint’: counted rollouts whose independent reconstruction (clinic: without calendar compatibility) agrees with the evaluator.
